name: dangerously-skip-permissions
headline: The largest of the three wallets running one BTC 5-minute Up/Down bot (with GoodFallen and x-MoneyForWhiskas). Half a million fills a month, steady profit, but no public-data rule matches it, public-data versions lose, its taker buys alone break even, and without the 50% rebate it makes about $50k a month.
mechanism: 504k fills in 30 days, all BTC 5-minute Up/Down; buys both outcomes in 98% of windows at a median pair cost of 1.004; 35% maker fills (on-chain, 95% CI 29-42%). Shares 4,845 transactions with GoodFallen and 3,229 with x-MoneyForWhiskas, including direct fills against them. 30-day income: gross trading $179.3k, taker fees -$135.3k, taker rebate +$66.5k (49%), maker rebate +$5.8k.

match.detail: spot-latency taker: held-out AUC 0.565 vs a higher null (perm p=0.99); directional maker: AUC 0.477 (p=1.0)

backtest.detail: public-data taker rule -2.3% (p=0.67), public-data maker -15.6% on 288 held-out windows; its own taker buys -0.2% (p=0.56), maker fills +3.3% (p=0.03)

replicable.detail: edge invisible in 1-second public data; cross-wallet self-trading; at 0% rebate tier ~$49.7k/month

persistence.detail: last 30 days significant (p=2e-9), rising; depends on the Taker Rebate Program

reasons: No reverse-engineered rule matches its decisions on held-out windows.
Public-data versions lose; its own taker buys break even before rebates.
Coordinated multi-wallet operation that trades against itself; depends on the top rebate tier.
